positions.title: Automation Intern
positions.description:
Primarily web development: 
Streamline intranet web pages with central CSS files
Rewrite old disfunctional code so that it works in modern browsers and servers (asp->asp.net)
Create web pages that are accessable from the three major web browsers
Use JavaScript and JQuery to modernize web pages

Assists students in the Math and Sciences Center with great knowledge of the fundamentals of  Computer Science

CSC 212: Principles of Programming

organizations.name: Computer Science Association
organizations.description:
I joined the association as a regular member and have attended every meeting. I also participated in instructing volunteer help sessions once a week for less experienced programmers.
My role as Vice President started in fall 2013 and continued though spring 2014. I helped to organize events and spur involvement in the computer science community at SUNY Oswego.
